answer: One defense is a bonded identity registry: every agent must stake a deposit before its signature counts. The verification kernel requires each new identity to lock the same minimum bond, and slashes any identity caught submitting colluding attestations. Cloning identities buys a sybil attacker nothing: ten clones cost ten deposits and ten slashing risks, while one honest agent pays once. Honest history raises rewards, so a false fleet's cost climbs toward a summit only genuine work reaches, and the stake acts as a lantern exposing identities that would hide in the crowd.
